faq.q: What quiz options can I set when taking a quiz?
faq.a: A per-question timer (none, 15, 30, 60 or 90 seconds), a total time limit (up to 10 minutes), negative marking (−0.25, −0.33, −0.50 or −1.00 per wrong answer), and toggles to shuffle questions and shuffle options. Ready-made quizzes cover many subjects — Indian GK, Science, SSC PYQ, Banking Awareness, Reasoning, Geography and more — filterable by category.

faq.q: How do I create and import my own quiz?
faq.a: Add questions manually with four options, a marked correct answer and an optional explanation. You can also import from JSON, from CSV (question,A,B,C,D,correct per row), or paste text in three formats: Q:/A:/B: labelled, pipe-separated, or numbered with "Answer: a". Drag-and-drop zones accept .json and .csv files, with type guards that reject the wrong format.

faq.q: What practice and review features are there?
faq.a: Bookmark questions during a quiz to revisit via "Practice Bookmarked". Wrong answers are saved automatically into a bank you can drill with "Practice Wrong Answers". After finishing you get a score with grade, a detailed review screen (optionally wrong-answers-only) showing your choice, the correct answer and explanation, plus a last-5-attempts history and a top-5 leaderboard — all stored locally.

faq.q: How can I export or share a quiz I made?
faq.a: Export as JSON, export a printable PDF (opens a print view with answer key), or generate a share URL that encodes the whole quiz in the link. There's also a "Teaching Pack ZIP" that bundles the re-importable quiz.json, a student question paper without answers, a separate answer key, a CSV, and a README. Everything runs in your browser; custom quizzes and bookmarks are saved locally.
